transport: LAN HTTP, fixed camera framing whole display

P0_registration: index strip ABCDEFGH.../01234567 (camera X to module map, mirror/reorder check, spans all groups left to right)
patterns.P2_fine: staggered drum-order sweep: module i shows drumOrder[(k+i) % N], k steps in drum order; one photo covers N distinct flaps
patterns.P3_boundaries: adjacent drum neighbors (A/B, M/N) for double-flap/binding
patterns.P4_repeatability: home, then same char 3x for lost-step/hall drift

notes: Drums move forward-only: always step patterns in drum order, never random.
Show frames are exact-width: length must equal numModules (local) or totalModules (fleet-wide distribute via master). Centering and scroll are forced off.
Poll GET /api/calib/status until busy==false, wait dwellMs, then shoot. GET /api/calib/frame?frameId=N is ground truth.
Preview is volatile RAM-only on the controller called (call each group directly for fleets); reload reverts. Persist via POST /api/calib/offsets (scope local or group 2..6 on master).
Calibration hold (mode 4) suspends date/time/random/scroll/MQTT/ESP-NOW writes; engage on every controller before starting, release when done.
